about: Reuse authority ledger for archived assembled-PC originals, read by tools/import_pc_media_archive.py owner_reuse_verifier on every registration and selection step. A decision covers exactly one archive (manifest_sha256). A withdrawal names a decision, a product_code and optionally an original_sha256 (null = every original of that product), with a non-empty reference to the owner's withdrawal. Unreadable or malformed ledger = deny all.

decisions.interpretation: Author's interpretation, not the owner's words: the selection basis is the first two references (18:35 and 18:41 KST: use the existing originals without regeneration) together with the scope the coordinator recorded (all 104 originals registered and selected as representative images without regeneration). The last two references (18:58 and 18:59 KST) authorize uploading to cloud storage and its extra cost only; they are not a selection approval. A configuration whose revision changed but whose case is the same is selected; one whose case changed is registered but not selected and is reported.
